# What changed — v0.1.0 to v0.2.0

**This is a FIXTURE migration, not a real one.** No real release ships a
migration; this file exists only so the runner's ordering, idempotency and
dry-run behaviour are exercisable as written.

This section is the **human-readable release note** — the prose a person reads to
understand the upgrade, carried in the same file as the agent-readable `apply:`
steps above. `upgrade-assay` (distribution/09) surfaces exactly this text as the
"release notes" for the step it is about to apply, so an adopter sees *what*
changes before consenting to *how* it is applied.

v0.2.0 records an adopter version-marker note in `docs/UPGRADING.txt`. The step is
idempotent: re-running it appends nothing once the note is present, and a
`--dry-run` previews the append without writing it.
